title: Two incomprehensible beings in a cave on Titan

tellings.quote: um I found these two beings in a cave.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who worked in remote viewing, the practice of trying to perceive distant places with the mind, tells the podcast host Jesse Michels that he once found two beings in a cave on Titan, the largest moon of Saturn. He describes them as beyond his understanding, and if true it would mean life exists elsewhere in our solar system.
